plain: A legal process for people or firms that cannot pay their debts

webster.text: The state of being a bankrupt, or insolvent; inability to pay all debts.

example.quote: The power of establishing uniform laws of bankruptcy is so intimately connected with the regulation of commerce, and will prevent so many frauds where the parties or their property may lie or be removed into different States, that the expediency of it seems not likely to be drawn into question.
